The 2026 Annual User Meeting will bring the OpenSpace community together for several days of demos, training sessions, and conversation about where the project is headed. Whether you run a planetarium, build for museum exhibits, teach with OpenSpace in classrooms, or contribute to the codebase, this is where the community connects.

## What to expect {.feature-h2}

Past meetings have included new feature previews from the development team, hands-on workshops for dome operators, lightning talks from users sharing how they've integrated OpenSpace into their venues, and open discussion about roadmap priorities. The 2026 program will follow a similar shape, with details added as they're confirmed.

## Registration

Registration opens in early 2026. Capacity is limited, so we'll announce on the OpenSpace mailing list and Slack first. Sign up below to get notified.

[Get notified when registration opens →](contact.qmd)
